source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The figures show good domain diversity across 248 domains. After checking 439 links, I found 275 indexed (62.6%) and 164 links unindexed (37.4%). There are two follow-ups: Re-indexing: Please submit all 164 unindexed links through an indexer; many are hosted on Notion, Sutori, Hightail, and ClickUp. Replacement: For links still unindexed after a couple of weeks, what is your policy—do you provide replacements?
